skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of distribution channels, their activities, and the nature of channel management.
Understand the activities of channel members and control principles.
Understand the characteristics of franchise trade and apply them in building and managing distribution channels.
Understand the content and process of building distribution channel strategies.
Understand the relationships within the channel, its operation, and issues arising in the channel.
Understand the content, principles, and operation of channel management.
Apply marketing and distribution channel knowledge to illustrate or solve specific problems related to distribution channels.
Propose strategies, solutions, and plans for channel management.
Apply general communication skills and marketing-specific skills in understanding and making decisions in channel management.
Apply independent and group work skills in building and implementing decisions in channel management.
